sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể có một thông dịch viên? is for asking permission before you act. It is useful when have an interpreter depends on local rules, staff approval, or the right way to use a space or service.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi có thể có một thông dịch viên? once, then make the task visible with your phone screen, receipt, item, photo, or the place where the issue is happening. The phrase is doing one job: getting a clear answer about have an interpreter.
